# Mixx-DJ-MCP — Full LLM Context

## What Is Mixx-DJ-MCP?

Mixx-DJ-MCP is a FastMCP 3.4+ server that bridges LLM agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, opencode) to [Mixxx](https://mixxx.org/) — the leading open-source DJ software. It communicates with Mixxx via OSC (Open Sound Control) using the [python-osc](https://pypi.org/project/python-osc/) library, translating natural-language requests into Mixxx Control Object (CO) commands.

The server uses the **industrial portmanteau pattern**: related operations are grouped into a single tool with an `operation` enum discriminator. Four portmanteau tools cover deck control, library, effects, and mixer, plus three Prefab UI cards for in-chat visualization.

**Version**: 0.1.0 — initial release. Tested against Mixxx 2.5.6.

## Quick Start

```bash
uv sync

# stdio mode (Claude Desktop)
uv run python -m mixx_dj_mcp.server

# HTTP mode (webapp + multi-client)
uv run uvicorn mixx_dj_mcp.server:app --port 11116 --reload

# Verify
curl http://127.0.0.1:11116/api/health
```

### Mixxx OSC Config (one-time)

1. Preferences → MIDI/OSC → Enable OSC
2. Output port: `11118`, Input port: `11119`, Send to: `127.0.0.1`
3. Restart Mixxx

## Architecture

```
Agent (Claude/Cursor/opencode)
    │ MCP stdio or HTTP
    ▼
mixx-dj-mcp (FastMCP 3.4+)
    │
    ├── mixx_deck(deck, operation, ...)          # 19 ops
    ├── mixx_library(operation, ...)             # 8 ops
    ├── mixx_effects(rack, unit, operation, ...) # 7 ops
    └── mixx_mixer(deck, operation, ...)         # 8 ops
    │   (plus 3 Prefab card tools)
    ▼ OSC UDP (port 11119 → Mixxx, 11118 ← Mixxx)
Mixxx 2.5+
    ├── Deck 1-4 (play, stop, cue, loop, sync, hot cues, scratch, rate, EQ, ...)
    ├── Mixer (crossfader, volume, gain, headphone, talkover, mic)
    ├── Effects (rack/unit chain, parameters, meta)
    └── Library (search, crate, playlist, load to deck)
```

## Tool Reference

### mixx_deck

Full deck control for decks 1-4.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `play_pause` | `deck` | Toggle play/pause |
| `stop` | `deck` | Stop playback |
| `load` | `deck`, `track_path` | Load track from file path |
| `cue_set` | `deck` | Set cue point at current position |
| `cue_play` | `deck` | Play from cue point |
| `loop_activate` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle loop on/off |
| `loop_beat` | `deck`, `beats` | Set beat loop (1-64) |
| `beatloop` | `deck`, `beats` | Same as loop_beat |
| `rate_set` | `deck`, `value` | Set playback rate (-1.0 to 1.0) |
| `rate_temp` | `deck`, `value` | Temporary pitch bend (seconds) |
| `sync_enable` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle sync lock |
| `sync_leader` | `deck`, `enable` | Set as sync leader |
| `seek` | `deck`, `value` | Seek to position in seconds |
| `scratch` | `deck`, `enable` | Enable/disable scratch mode |
| `hotcue_activate` | `deck`, `hotcue` | Activate hotcue (1-8) |
| `quantize` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle beat quantization |
| `keylock` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle keylock |
| `video_enable` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle video playback on/off |
| `video_fullscreen` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle video fullscreen on/off |

**Return format:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Deck 1: play/pause toggled",
  "data": {"deck": 1}
}
```

### mixx_library

Library search and navigation.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `search` | `query` | Full-text search in library |
| `browse_crate` | `crate` | Browse tracks in a crate |
| `browse_playlist` | `playlist` | Browse tracks in a playlist |
| `load_selected` | `deck` | Load highlighted track to deck |
| `get_track_info` | `deck` | Get metadata for current track |
| `get_bpm` | `deck` | Get BPM of current track |
| `get_key` | `deck` | Get musical key of current track |
| `get_replay_gain` | `deck` | Get replay gain values |

**Return format:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Searching library for: tech house",
  "data": {"query": "tech house"}
}
```

### mixx_effects

Effect chain management and parameter control.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `list_effects` | `rack`, `unit` | List available effects |
| `chain_load` | `rack`, `unit`, `effect` | Load effect chain by name |
| `chain_clear` | `rack`, `unit` | Clear all effects from chain |
| `parameter_set` | `rack`, `unit`, `parameter`, `value` | Set effect parameter (0.0-1.0) |
| `meta_set` | `rack`, `unit`, `value` | Set meta/param knob (0.0-1.0) |
| `quick_effect_set` | `deck`, `effect` | Set quick effect on deck |
| `effect_enable` | `rack`, `unit`, `enable` | Enable/disable effect unit |

### mixx_mixer

Mixer channel control.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `crossfader_set` | `value` | Set crossfader (-1.0 to 1.0) |
| `crossfader_curve` | `value` | Set crossfader curve (0.0-1.0) |
| `gain_set` | `deck`, `value` | Set deck pregain (0.0-5.0) |
| `eq_set` | `deck`, `eq_band`, `value` | Set EQ band (high/mid/low, 0.0-1.0) |
| `volume_set` | `deck`, `value` | Set channel volume (0.0-1.0) |
| `headphone_cue` | `deck`, `enable` | Toggle headphone cue (PFL) |
| `talkover` | `enable` | Toggle microphone talkover |
| `mic_gain` | `value` | Set microphone gain (0.0-1.0) |

### Prefab UI Cards

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `show_deck_status_card(deck)` | Rich card with play state, BPM, key, gain, volume, sync, loop |
| `show_mixer_status_card()` | Rich card with crossfader position and per-deck levels |
| `show_library_status_card()` | Rich card showing OSC connection and port info |

## Mixxx OSC Address Reference

### Deck Transport (`/deck/[1-4]/...`)

| Address | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `/deck/[N]/play` | 1.0 | Toggle play/pause |
| `/deck/[N]/stop` | 1.0 | Stop playback |
| `/deck/[N]/LoadTrack` | string | Load track by path |
| `/deck/[N]/cue_set` | 1.0 | Set cue point |
| `/deck/[N]/cue_play` | 1.0 | Play from cue |
| `/deck/[N]/seek` | float | Seek to seconds |
| `/deck/[N]/rate` | -1.0 to 1.0 | Set playback rate |
| `/deck/[N]/rate_temp` | float | Temporary pitch bend (seconds) |
| `/deck/[N]/sync_enabled` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle sync lock |
| `/deck/[N]/sync_leader` | 1.0/0.0 | Set as sync leader |
| `/deck/[N]/loop_enabled` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle loop |
| `/deck/[N]/beatloop_[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]` | 1.0 | Activate beat loop |
| `/deck/[N]/hotcue_[1-8]_activated` | 1.0 | Activate hotcue |
| `/deck/[N]/quantize` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle quantize |
| `/deck/[N]/keylock` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle keylock |
| `/deck/[N]/scratch` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle scratch mode |
| `/deck/[N]/video_enabled` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle video playback on/off |
| `/deck/[N]/video_fullscreen` | 1.0/0.0 | Toggle video fullscreen window |
| `/video_crossfader` | 0.0-1.0 | Global video crossfader blend |

### Deck EQ/Filter (`/deck/[1-4]/...`)

| Address | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `/deck/[N]/pregain` | 0.0-5.0 | Pregain/trim |
| `/deck/[N]/volume` | 0.0-1.0 | Channel volume |
| `/deck/[N]/pfl` | 1.0/0.0 | Headphone cue (pre-fader listen) |
| `/deck/[N]/filterHigh` | 0.0-1.0 | High EQ |
| `/deck/[N]/filterMid` | 0.0-1.0 | Mid EQ |
| `/deck/[N]/filterLow` | 0.0-1.0 | Low EQ |

### Mixer

| Address | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `/crossfader` | -1.0 to 1.0 | Crossfader position |
| `/crossfader/curve` | 0.0-1.0 | Crossfader curve |
| `/talkover` | 1.0/0.0 | Microphone talkover |
| `/microphone/gain` | 0.0-1.0 | Mic gain |

### Effects (`/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/...`)

| Address | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/enabled` | 1.0/0.0 | Enable/disable unit |
| `/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/chain_load` | string | Load chain by name |
| `/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/chain_clear` | 1.0 | Clear chain |
| `/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/meta` | 0.0-1.0 | Meta knob |
| `/EffectRack[N]_EffectUnit[N]/parameter[N]` | 0.0-1.0 | Effect parameter |

### Library

| Address | Value | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| `/library/search` | string | Search library |
| `/library/load_selected` | float | Load selected to deck |
| `/library/crate/[name]/select` | 1.0 | Browse crate |
| `/library/playlist/[name]/select` | 1.0 | Browse playlist |

### OSC Feedback (Mixxx → us, port 11118)

| Address | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/deck/[N]/play` | Play state (1.0/0.0) |
| `/deck/[N]/bpm` | Current BPM |
| `/deck/[N]/rate` | Current rate adjustment |
| `/deck/[N]/volume` | Channel volume |
| `/deck/[N]/pregain` | Channel pregain |
| `/deck/[N]/sync_enabled` | Sync lock state |
| `/deck/[N]/loop_enabled` | Loop state |
| `/deck/[N]/keylock` | Keylock state |
| `/deck/[N]/pfl` | Headphone cue state |
| `/deck/[N]/track_samples` | Track position in samples |
| `/deck/[N]/track_samplerate` | Track sample rate |
| `/crossfader` | Crossfader position |

## REST API

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/health` | GET | Server health + Mixxx connection status |
| `/api/deck/status` | GET | Live deck states (play, BPM, volume, etc.) |
| `/api/settings` | GET | Current OSC/host configuration |
| `/api/v1/diagnostics` | GET | Full diagnostics (tool count, OSC status, system) |
| `/api/skills` | GET | List available skills |
| `/api/skills/{name}` | GET | Get skill content |
| `/docs` | GET | Swagger UI |
| `/redoc` | GET | ReDoc |
| `/openapi.json` | GET | OpenAPI schema |
| `/mcp` | POST | MCP streamable HTTP transport |

Health response:
```json
{"status": "ok", "server": "mixx-dj-mcp", "version": "0.1.0", "uptime_seconds": 42, "tool_count": 15, "providers": {"mixxx": true}}
```

## Configuration

| Env Var | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `MIXX_MCP_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Server bind address |
| `MIXX_MCP_PORT` | 11116 | Server HTTP port |
| `MIXX_OSC_OUT_PORT` | 11118 | OSC output (Mixxx feedback) |
| `MIXX_OSC_IN_PORT` | 11119 | OSC input (send to Mixxx) |
| `MIXX_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Mixxx host address |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | info | Logging level |
| `MIXX_TAURI` | 0 | Set to 1 when launched from Tauri wrapper |

## Project Structure

```
mixx-dj-mcp/
├── src/
│   └── mixx_dj_mcp/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── __main__.py           # Entry point: python -m mixx_dj_mcp
│       ├── server.py             # FastMCP app, FastAPI app, lifespan, health endpoints
│       ├── http_app.py           # FastAPI factory + CORS + MCP mount
│       ├── config.py             # MixxConfig from env
│       ├── transport.py          # Transport type enum
│       ├── bridge/
│       │   ├── __init__.py
│       │   ├── osc_bridge.py     # OSC UDP client (send + receive + state tracking)
│       │   └── protocol.py       # OSC address constants and CO mappings
│       └── tools/
│           ├── __init__.py       # register_all_tools()
│           ├── deck_control.py   # mixx_deck portmanteau
│           ├── library.py        # mixx_library portmanteau
│           ├── effects.py        # mixx_effects portmanteau
│           ├── mixer.py          # mixx_mixer portmanteau
│           └── prefab_cards.py   # show_*_status_card Prefab tools
├── tests/
│   ├── test_bridge.py            # 9 tests (OSC addresses, bridge mock)
│   ├── test_deck_control.py      # 11 tests (play, stop, sync, rate, load, ...)
│   ├── test_effects.py           # 9 tests (chain load/clear, params, enable)
│   └── test_mixer.py             # 12 tests (crossfader, EQ, volume, headphone, ...)
├── web_sota/                     # React 19 / Vite 6 / Tailwind 4 webapp
├── native/                       # Tauri 2.0 NSIS build
├── mcpb/                         # MCPB bundle assets
├── scripts/
│   ├── cua-smoke.py              # CUA-NSIS smoke test
│   └── install-mcp-clients.ps1   # MCP client registration
├── .env.example
├── start.ps1 / start.bat
├── pyproject.toml
├── justfile
├── llms.txt / llms-full.txt
└── glama.json
```

## Development

### just recipes

```bash
just lint        # ruff check + format
just test        # pytest (41 tests)
just serve       # uv run uvicorn ... --port 11116
just build-native  # Tauri NSIS build
just cua-nsis-test # CUA smoke test
just e2e         # Playwright E2E
```

### Testing

```bash
uv run pytest tests/ -q
uv run pytest tests/ -v --tb=short
```

### Linting

```bash
uv run ruff check src/
uv run ruff format src/ --check
```

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely Cause | Solution |
|---------|-------------|----------|
| `OSCError: [Errno 10061]` | Mixxx not running or OSC not enabled | Start Mixxx, verify Preferences → MIDI/OSC |
| Commands sent but no effect | Mixxx OSC port mismatch | Verify ports in .env match Mixxx preferences |
| `Connection refused` on 11118/11119 | Port conflict | Check `netstat -ano` for other apps on these ports |
| Library operations return no data | Mixxx library not loaded | Ensure tracks are in Mixxx library |
| Tools not showing in client | FastMCP import issue | Verify `tools/__init__.py` has all imports |
| Webapp shows "Backend offline" | Backend not running or port mismatch | Run `uv run uvicorn ... --port 11116`, check health |
| Mixxx 2.5.6 at C:\Program Files\Mixxx\ | Standard install path | Verify with `where mixxx` |
